issues.title: Backfilled identities get last_sign_in_at = null
issues.explanation: The column allows null, but the client SDK types require last_sign_in_at, so every backfilled identity crashed strongly typed clients (Flutter). Fixed by follow-up migration 20221208132122 (PR #850), which set it to '2022-11-25' on these rows.
issues.fix: Insert a non-null value, e.g. '2022-11-25' as last_sign_in_at (matching created_at).

issues.title: encrypted_password != '' skips passwordless and invited users
issues.explanation: The spec covers email-passwordless users too, but those (and invited users who have not set a password) have encrypted_password = '', so they get no email identity. A later migration (PR #914) had to backfill invited users separately with invited_at is not null.
issues.fix: Select on email is not null (plus invited_at / confirmed users as intended) instead of requiring a non-empty password.

issues.title: not exists matches identities of any provider
issues.explanation: The subquery does not filter on provider, so a user who already has e.g. a google identity is treated as having an email identity and is skipped. The follow-up backfill (PR #914) correlates on provider = 'email'.
issues.fix: not exists (select 1 from auth.identities where user_id = users.id and provider = 'email')
